task: Find a day-use park that offers horseback riding near Nashville.
agent_final_answer: Cook Day Use Area is a day-use park near Nashville that offers horseback riding. It is part of J Percy Priest Lake (US Army Corps of Engineers), located near Hermitage, Tennessee, about 10 miles east of downtown Nashville. Its facility description (Recreation section) lists horseback riding among the activities visitors can choose from: "fishing, hunting, picnicking, boating, canoeing, hiking, horseback riding and wildlife viewing." Found via the recreation.gov search "horseback riding Nashville." (Note: the other day-use sites at the same lake - Smith Springs, Jefferson Springs, and the Seven Points day-use area - share the same description and likewise mention horseback riding.)
